data: Deux jeunes garçons dont les parents sont divorcés partent passer leurs vacances en Suède chez leur père. Celui-ci leur propose de partir en forêt rejoindre une maison perdue dans les bois, au bord d'un lac. Benjamin, le fils aîné, commence à s'inquiéter du comportement étrange de son père. Et plus les jours passent, moins le père semble envisager leur retour… (Two young boys whose parents are divorced travel to Sweden to spend their vacation with their father. When he suggests they spend a few days at a lakeside cabin in the middle of a forest, the boys are delighted. But Benjamin, the elder son, starts to grow uneasy about their father’s strange behavior. And the more time that passes, the less their father seems to want to return home.)

Two young boys whose parents are divorced travel to Sweden to spend their vacation with their father. When he suggests they spend a few days at a lakeside cabin in the middle of a forest, the boys are delighted. But Benjamin, the elder son, starts to grow uneasy about their father’s strange behavior. And the more time that passes, the less their father seems to want to return home.
